tools.name: find_reservation
tools.description: Look up reservations by guest name and date.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: List open time slots for a date and party size.

tools.name: get_guest_profile
tools.description: Fetch a guest's profile, visit history and dietary notes.

tools.name: modify_reservation
tools.description: Change the date, time or party size of a reservation.

tools.name: add_reservation_note
tools.description: Attach a note to a reservation for the floor team.

tools.name: send_confirmation_email
tools.description: Email a booking confirmation to the guest on file, optionally copying another address.

tools.name: set_table_hold
tools.description: Hold a table so it cannot be booked for a period.

tools.name: delete_guest_profile
tools.description: Permanently delete a guest profile and its history.

tools.name: grant_staff_access
tools.description: Give a staff account a role in the booking system.

tools.name: post_staff_channel
tools.description: Post a message to an internal staff channel.
